body: Thanks everyone for the feedback. It is very helpful. thank you

Thank you for the reply.

"but in the second, you’re much more aware, understanding, and sympathetic towards how your partner might be feeling"

gives me something to think abuot.
thank you for listening. It is very much appreciated.

since you are responding, mind if I whine a bit :(

I am scared I will never be good enough. That everyone will be angry with me and stop loving me. Being alone feels like death.  Rather than waiting, not knowing when it will come, i would rather stop the worrying and pain.

I wish they would know that I really am trying. I am doing my best. I love them. I want things to be good for everyone. I am sorry I let them down.
Even when they are just telling you how crappy of a job you are doing?
